description: This file contains unit tests for various functions related to gateway session invocation timeouts and URL manipulation within the 'ai.openclaw.app.gateway' package. It uses JUnit for testing and verifies behavior of functions like formatting gateway authorities, building WebSocket URLs, resolving timeout values, and replacing capability tokens in URLs.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTimeoutTest
classes.description: A test suite for verifying gateway session timeout handling, URL formatting, and token replacement functionality.

methods.name: formatGatewayAuthority_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests the formatting of gateway authority string with IPv6 addresses enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_bracketsIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests building WebSocket URLs with IPv6 addresses, with and without TLS.

methods.name: buildGatewayWebSocketUrl_normalizesPersistedBracketedIpv6Hosts
methods.description: Tests normalization of URL with IPv6 address that already includes brackets.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesFloorWhenMissingOrTooSmall
methods.description: Verifies that the timeout value defaults to a minimum of 15,000 ms when null or too small.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_usesInvokeBudgetWithinBounds
methods.description: Checks that timeout values within bounds are returned correctly.

methods.name: resolveInvokeResultAckTimeoutMs_capsAtUpperBound
methods.description: Ensures timeout values exceeding the upper bound are capped at 120,000 ms.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesTerminalCapabilitySegment
methods.description: Tests replacement of the capability token segment in a URL.

methods.name: replaceCanvasCapabilityInScopedHostUrl_rewritesWhenQueryAndFragmentPresent
methods.description: Tests URL token replacement when query parameters and fragment are present.
